corrections.Raw_text:
I love the selection of beautiful household decorations. I’ve been delighted with the two area rugs I have bought from Lulu and Georgia. I have some furniture, rugs, and gifts on order waiting to receive.
The only reason why I am giving a 4 and not a five is for two reasons. One the shipping g charges are astronomical which makes it even hard to afford items when they are on sale because the discount actually goes to the shipping.
Secondly, I think being able to talk to a human voice for customer service makes me feel better. Just that personal touch will go a long way! That being said I do get an email back when I do have a question or a concern. However I would love to talk to a designer or representative about your products and design.
All in all you carry beautiful original things you won’t see everyone have. That makes your company unique. 😍
Thanks,

I am so sad to write this because I love the collections that LuLu and Georgia carry but the customer service here is UNACCEPTABLE.
I have been a decorator for over 30 years and I have never had a company that works with the trade so dismissive and irresponsible
My marble top table arrived broken in 4 large pieces. After months of sending photographs of the table, the boxes it arrived in, the crate… I was told I would receive a replacement. This was over a year ago.
My attempted calls and messages are never returned nor are my emails.
I’m sure they are fine to work with, but Candace, who works with the trade clients is not some one I would recommend working with. Ever.

I have bought quite a few pieces this year from Lulu and Georgia. I had excellent experiences with customer service, who were quick to replace a pricey coffee table that was not assembled properly upon arrival. They Also refunded me for the big item fees for the entire order for my trouble.
I had also reached out once after noticing that a piece of furniture I had just ordered had gone on sale before mine was ever even delivered… they immediately offered me store credit for the difference which I was perfectly happy with.
I don’t know why people have such bad things to say about their customer service. My experience so far has been nothing but satisfying.
I have purchased furniture, decor, lighting, etc- all types of products from L & G…each one was beautiful, high quality piece that were exactly as pictured online.

corrections.Raw_text:
Orders the 90” Fabienne slipcovered sofa. I am thoroughly obsessed! The most beautiful sofa I’ve ever owned. Sleek, classy and dreamy. The fact that it’s fully slipcovered is a huge plus! I’m a sucker for nice looking things and I’ve found that a lot of slipcovered sofas out there just aren’t the aesthetic I’d like but this one hits the nail. I always worry about feather filled sofas and Read more about review stating Incrediblehow long the cushions will stay plump, but I really don’t have worries with this one as the cushions are extremely thick. We also don’t sink down to the floor with it which is SO nice- it’s soft and firm! Also love that it’s a bench seat and a bench back cushion which makes it unique to other sofas!
The sofa was delivered a lot sooner than we expected and arrived via white glove delivery!!

Exchanged the item, still haven't received the rest of the original order but replacement item came.... damaged. Just reached our to customer service for round two. Can't say I love spending my time on things like these.
Update. I ordered a few different items. A few days later I told friend about the items I ordered, she then placed the same order. Her items came 2 days ago. I'm still waiting. I just received email saying one of my items is out of stock! Glad she got hers afyer placing her order afyer mine :(

A full refund has been issued per your request and your other items will be delivered tomorrow by end of the day. If you have any further questions or concerns, please reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.

corrections.Raw_text: I've been looking for a new living room area rug, because the one I have now is rather non-descript. L&G has a wide selection of bold, stylish designs, and I was able to easily find one I liked! The ordering process was very straightforward, and I received frequent updates on the delivery status, which was fairly quick considering today's supply chain issues. The rug enhances my living room beautifully, and I've received several compliments! I'd rate the quality 4/5 - it's not a top-of-the-line item, but for the price I paid, I'm not surprised or disappointed. My only minor complaint ... the rug was fairly dusty when I unpacked it, and I cleaned it thoroughly with a mild, non-chemical product before I put it down on the floor (which I think is a good thing to do with any rug you order from anywhere!). Also, the company barrages you with email and text ads, which gets annoying after a while. Overall, though, I'm very pleased!

corrections.Raw_text:
Quick shipping. Good quality product, great color and durable material, easy to put together. Took me about an hour at a relaxed pace.
Only cons I see:
For such an expensive item, the assembly instructions leave much to be desired. One part of my instructions had certain parts mixed up.
Also, unless you have a near 2ft height mattress, you will need a box spring, there will be a gap between the mattress and headboard without one. Secondly the support bars at the bottom of the frame are spread too far apart and your mattress will sink in between them without some reinforcement. We have a 13” height mattress and we added a 9” box spring and it works perfectly.

I ordered 2 furniture items on May 27th. After dealing with their movers, Metropolitan movers, who took a while to fill out the COI correctly, the move was scheduled for today. I just called the movers and was told that they are no longer delivering the coffee table since it didn't pass inspection! Never heard from Lulu & Georgia who should be aware of this.
Also, I still haven't heard anything about when the desk will be delivered. Nothing on their website mentioned it would take weeks for delivery when i purchased the items.
Also, never heard of a furniture company who doesn't take phone calls and there is NO ONE to speak to on the phone! Had I known this, I never would have purchased from this company.

corrections.Raw_text:
I really wanted to like the product. Lulu and Georgia has a fun back story and history. To be fair, this is not a Lulu and Georgia exclusive, this is something drop shopped from a vendor with whom they have a supply agreement -- but it is in Lulu and Georgia's catalog.
The installation guide is a joke. But even with a good installation guide, this is not well suited for installation in any form. The fabric sheath over the white wide cord does not easily pass through the two black pieces needed to secure the fixture. I've put up dozens and dozens of lights for friends, family, and myself over the years, and I'll eventually get this light hung. But its unnecessarily complex to hang such a simple fixture.
I also was enticed by the good pricing, which had a "final sale" disclaimer. Buyer beware, the Lulu and Georgia vetting process is not enough to stand behind to ensure a good product. From Lulu and Georgia please consider only buying things that can be returned. Once they improve their vetting process maybe such a defensive maneuver will be necessary.
corrections.Support_reply:
Hi Alan, we’re so sorry to hear about this experience with us and thank you so much for your feedback. We have shared this with our teams and are continuing to work with our suppliers to improve the installation guides that accompany our lighting fixtures. I apologize for any inconvenience. We are more than happy to help with some alternative suggestions. Just reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com if you’re interested.

corrections.Raw_text:
I like the product offerings. They are unique and interesting.
I have ordered multiple times and several thousand dollars worth of product. This review is not a one-off or an unusual and isolated situation.
I very much dislike the inventory process. Oftentimes (not just a one off), items are ordered that are supposedly in stock. Then some days later, you’re informed they’re back ordered for months. Their inventory system needs substantial improvement.
The other huge flaw for Lulu and Georgia is their delivery information. On the site, it will just say ITEM NOT FULFILLED. Period. No estimate of ship or delivery date. It’s really frustrating. I order A LOT of furniture and decor, and I have found their system to be the very worst of any of the higher end businesses.
Lastly, another very frustrating issue is when things are unexpectedly backordered (even if it showed in stock at the time of purchase), you can’t easily cancel the item. You are forced to call, which is likewise complicated. Just trying to find the phone number is extraordinarily difficult.
corrections.Support_reply:
Hi Kris,
Thank you for reaching out and we're sorry to hear about your experience with us. This is not an experience we wish for any of our customers but please know your feedback is very important to us. We will get a representative to further assist you with your order. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com or for immediate assistance, we do offer chat M-F from 9 am-5 pm PST so you can speak to a live person.

corrections.Raw_text:
Unfortunately this is the second time I had a quality control issue with a L&G purchase. I’m an interior designer, so when I purchase things for clients and projects, and the item arrives looking used or showing signs of previous use, it doesn’t reflect well on me. I purchased a lamp for my client, the lamp arrived kinda looking like it had been handled previously, which isn’t usually a big deal. A good wipe or a clean depending on what it is, usually does the trick. But I plugged this lamp into my clients electrical outlet, it pulled a large amount of power, popped the outlet and breaker and then the cord became very warm to the touch. L&G was accommodating when I reached out, offered to refund or replace, however the short caused my clinet to have to call an electrican for a service call. Just resetting the breaker cost my client more to pay an electrican to come out and service the issue, but she spent more on the electrician then we did on the actual lamp. She was pissed and I had to come out of pocket to make sure my client wasn’t feeling bad about it.
It’s not directly L&G’s fault, but this is a major quality control issue, which IS the same type of issue I had with a previous L&G order. I’ve waisted time and money twice and it’s cost OOP expenses, so to say I’m reluctant to source from L&G as a professional for future projects is an understatement. It’s unfortunate.

corrections.Raw_text:
Lulu and Georgia, when am I going to receive my order ORDER #565626 THAT WAS PLACED 3 WEEKS AGO.
I am about to call my credit card and cancel your charge as I have no communication on my order. You are the first company in 10 years that I have experienced this with. Tamara mentioned my order is placed and I would be receiving a shipping confirmation and still nothing.
I placed an order with Food 52 same time as I did with you, I have experienced exceptional communication and service from them. Not only have I received my order but some broken dishes have also been replaced and received. I also placed orders with CB2 and other companies at the same time as yours, all have been received with exceptional communication from the vendors in email.
I expect to receive a call today regarding my shipping status from a manager. This is appalling
Thank you
Sabina
corrections.Support_reply:
Hi Sabina, thank you for your feedback, and we're sorry about the delay with your order. We're excited to share that your order shipped earlier today.

corrections.Raw_text:
We purchased the Lee Dresser by Sarah Sherman Samuel and received it two days ago. There is a huge quality problem with this item - it is absolutely terrible. The drawers are "push to open" and they barely open!! In order to open some of the drawers I literally have to bang on the dresser, which makes it wobble and shake. Some of the drawers do not close all the way making the piece look broken and cheap. The color is also so much different than pictured - much darker. I could live with this if not for the major quality and functionality problems.
Upon receiving the dresser I immediately sent a return request to the "customer service" email. I have yet to receive a response. There is no phone number to contact this company and ZERO customer service. This is totally unacceptable for a $3k piece of furniture.
This company is a scam and I will be contacting AmEx to report it as such unless I hear back from someone by the end of this week.

corrections.Raw_text:
If you plan on buying a lamp or vase, this company might be fine, but after spending $7K on furniture, the customer service and quality of furniture are extremely frustrating. My designer picked out an ottoman and couch from Lulu and bought them per the recommendation. Here was my experience.
The ottoman came quickly but was in a box completely un-padded/secured. Literally, thrown in a box with some plastic wrap. The $800 ottoman was left outside our city apartment building. A plastic piece on the interior of the ottoman was broken, but whatever. I moved on.
The couch - We were originally quoted 5-7 weeks for the couch. A few weeks after placing the order we realized the measurements were off and we might want a different couch. There is NO one to call or speak with. Via email, they say if the couch hasn't started being built, we can cancel. Finally hear back and they tell us we can't cancel. "Fine I say, does that mean it will be here soon/er?". Lulu, "No, the couch will still be an additional 6 weeks." I was pissed, but my fault for not checking the policies.
The cherry on top - I go to the website and see the couch is now 25% off. I reached out and asked if they could honor that discount given my couch is still over a month out from being delivered. No - they will not honor the sale. In summary, I am paying $6k for a couch that will take over 8 weeks to receive, doesn't fit well in my space, and is now discounted to $5K.
corrections.Support_reply:
Hi Natasha, Thank you for reaching out and we're sorry to hear about your experience with us. We're truly grateful for your feedback and understand your concerns regarding our customer service accessibility, our shipping service, and our price adjustment policies. As noted on the product page, the ottoman is delivered curbside delivery only and not white glove. We're sorry for the trouble. As for the made to order sofa, unfortunately, we're unable to guarantee cancellations once they have been submitted as it is instantly sent to our distribution warehouse for processing. We want to clarify that we honor price adjustments for full-priced items if they go on sale within 7 days of your purchase, provided no other offers were applied. These adjustments are issued as store credit for the difference, excluding taxes. Please note that we can't combine promotional offers, including site-wide and shipping discounts. Our Customer Experience team made an exception to our policies, and honored the price adjustment for your order in the form of store credit.
Your input is invaluable, and we'll certainly consider it as we strive to improve our services. We are available on Live Chat Monday-Friday 9am-5pm PST and we also offer scheduled phone call backs, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with.

corrections.Raw_text:
I ordered two throw pillows. I paid $21.95 to have them shipped - and that's not even "priority". I got one pillow promptly, but I was strung along on the other one for almost a month before I finally asked them to cancel the order. The pillow was still showing up as available/in stock on their website, yet they told me when I contacted them that they could not get it from their supplier. After I cancelled the order I had to ask them to also refund some of the shipping as shipping is a sliding scale based on the amount you purchase and it wasn't fair for me to have paid based on the full amount of both pillows.
I don't think I will bother doing business with them again as I think you should be able to trust that your order will ship more or less when the website says it will ship at the time you order it.

Hi Jennifer, thank you for your feedback and we are so sorry to hear that the second pillow from your order did not ship out. Apologies for the inconveniences that this caused you. We can see that our Customer Experience team supported you by issuing a full refund for the pillow. They also provided a discount code good toward your next purchase with us. We apologize for this experience with us, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help you with.

corrections.Raw_text:
I wish I saw these ratings before purchasing an entire bedroom set with a king size bed, night stands, mirror, rug and a side table. Out of all of these items, I only liked the mirror. Knowing that the bed color can vary because it's velvet, I still opted for this knowing velvet coloring can appear different - so long as it was within the color family (btw, it wasn't at all). What we got was a DAMAGED bed with the velvet looking aged and very dirty only in the upper right section, it appears that section had exposure from improper storage. Even the delivery guys noticed it looked odd. CS tried to help and provide tips but to steam + brush a $3K bed to still be left with something that looks a 20 yr old item we got from a vintage store is ridiculous. DO NOT buy anything non-returnable, even when it is damaged, they don't take responsibility and claim its totally intended.
Overall, this will be my first and last purchase as everything looked cheap for what you spend. The shipping is extremely expensive and not all of my items were shipped white glove service despite believing it was, other furniture stores are a fraction of the price.

I purchased a painting. In the description it says the painting will take time as they are custom made by the artist. We waited 4 weeks and when it arrives there was no signature by the artist which puzzled me. I wrote to the company and expressed my concern. One week later they wrote that it is a copy of the painting. It was 2600.00! I now am asking what they are going to do about it - it was a gift. Still no answer. Basically they are counterfeit and I am reporting the company to the police because they keep stringing me along. Stay away. I will write back to this review if I hear from them.
I received a response from you and submitted the order number. I don’t understand why you seem so shocked over my review. I have been dealing with Mico from your company and he said he escalated it. I have not heard a word for resolution.

corrections.Raw_text:
Poor craftsmanship, no attention to detail, no quality control. Non existent customer service phone number. Would not buy from them again.
Edit: the review was written after the replacement was delivered; the replacement was also in unacceptable condition. A sales associate did help out and provided a couple options - 1) get it replaced for a second time (which meant I had to disassemble the safety gates at the top and bottom of the stairs for the third time) or 2) keep it as is and get $650 credited to my account. I took the latter because option 1 was too inconvenient for me with a baby. I’m not sure if I just had terrible luck or if all of the furniture items lack the quality control (I’ve purchased decor from here in the past and had been very happy with the quality, after this experience I will stick to decor). The customer service rep was very friendly and responsive. So I will give credit where it’s due.
corrections.Support_reply:
Hi Ana, thank you for reaching out and sharing your experience. We’re truly saddened to hear about the condition of the dresser and the inconvenience this has caused. We noticed that you have been in touch with our Customer Experience team, they have escalated the issue and sent a replacement order which was recently delivered. For assistance in the future, you can reach our team via Live Chat from Monday to Friday, 9am-5pm PST, or schedule a phone call back. If there’s anything else we can assist you with, please let us know!

As lovely as their products are their customer service and lack of communication make ordering a frustrating ordeal. I would not recommending ordering online from a company that puts so little effort into customer service. I ordered a couple of chairs 3 months ago, and the only communication other than the initial confirmation was last month stating my chairs would be arriving on said date only to be followed by more email with different dates. Still no chairs and no reply to my communications.
I also need to add that I do not regret my 1 star review even after Lulu and Georgia replied to this review given how many 1 star reviews they have on yelp. This company needs a serious and aggressive overhaul if it wants to attract and retain customers.

We appreciate your patience and understanding in this matter.

corrections.Raw_text:
Lulu and Georgia should be ashamed of themselves. Either they have unrealistic definitions of what a “defective” product is, or they willingly engage in deceptive advertising.
I purchased the Mahoe Oval Coffee Table from Lulu and Georgia on March 6, 2025, for a total of $2031.52. The images online where of a beautiful travertine coffee table in light, neutral colors, with no mention of variances.
I received the table on March 18 and it was nowhere near close to the image of what I ordered and was far different than the reasonable amount of "natural" variation – it was a color-blocked table with a white top and dark brown, stark contrast, legs. It was awful. I rejected the delivery and they placed a new order.
I received a replacement on March 31, and same thing, and a third on May 22, also the same thing.
I requested a full refund, either to my original payment and/or store credit.
They are refunding $1496.51 to my credit card and another $264.09 as store credit, for a total “refunded” of $1760.60. There is a delta of $269.92.
The "store credit" was the "restocking fee", since they are claiming that the item is not defective. However, the item is clearly defective. If what I received wasn’t defective, then it is most certainly deceptive advertising.
I would be more than generous and accept the delta as part of the "store credit", giving them the chance for suture business. However, I cannot accept this delta when this is clearly either a defective item or deceptive advertising.
I have spent countless hours corresponding back and forth with the “CX/Customer Experience” team to no avail. They should be ashamed of themselves. This is the worst experience I have ever had with a furniture order, and I cannot believe I am being swindled by them. I guess this is what I get for blindly purchasing from a store I found advertised on Instagram and through various “influencers”.
Please be aware that purchasing from Lulu and Georgia will be a crapshoot – you may or may not receive what something similar to what you purchased, and if you don’t, you will be out money for “restocking” fees and delivery fees.

corrections.Raw_text:
We recently purchased the Rutherford Round Dining Table from Lulu & Georgia, along with their white glove delivery service. Unfortunately, the table arrived without the correct hardware, and the delivery team could not assemble it.
What has been most frustrating is the lack of support — Lulu & Georgia has no customer service phone line, only email. Their team suggested that we source the hardware ourselves (after we already paid for delivery + setup) and offered only $50 as compensation. Their “solution” is essentially for us to spend time hunting for the right hardware ourselves, with a week old newborn, then let them know once we find it so they can send someone back. We now have a $2,400 table sitting in our dining room, unassembled, while we try to track down compatible hardware on our own.
Instead of offering to send the proper hardware, they want to make it incredibly inconvenient for our new family.
The communication has been slow and sporadic, with no proactive solution offered. For a premium brand charging premium prices, this has been a very disappointing experience. I would caution others to be aware of the lack of direct support before making such a big purchase. Be careful with the white glove option because if anything is missing they will tell you that they are third party and you need to contact the store which begins the cycle while you hunt for parts.
We tried Amazon, Lowe’s, Home Depot, tractor supply….We just wanted the product we paid for, set up as promised. It’s disappointing that a company at this price point offers so little support when things go wrong. Instead of sending the hardware it was placed on us. 50$ refund and half off the installment is the measly price for our wasted time.

corrections.Raw_text:
$900 spent. Three incorrect orders. Two months wasted. Zero accountability.
This has easily been the worst customer experience I’ve had with any company.
I ordered a pillow in a specific color for $150 plus shipping. Instead of receiving the correct item, I was sent the wrong color three separate times.
After the second mistake, customer service assured me they had escalated the issue and personally spoke with the supplier to ensure the third shipment would finally be correct. It wasn’t. The third order arrived wrong again.
Only after the third failure did customer service admit that this is a known issue with the item. If the company already knows there’s a problem fulfilling this product correctly, why is it still being sold on the website?
At first I was told to keep or discard the incorrect pillows. Later I was asked to return the wrong item, adding yet another inconvenience after already waiting more than two months for the correct product.
Customer service is also extremely difficult to reach. There is no direct phone support, even after I requested a call. Your only options are sending emails and waiting indefinitely for a reply or sitting in chat hoping someone eventually responds.
To add insult to injury, shipping is outrageously expensive. I spent over $900 on several pillows, and shipping alone was around $90. After months of mistakes and repeated inconvenience, the company’s solution was to refund $20 in shipping.
I was also offered a refund, but that’s not a real solution when I ordered multiple pillows specifically to match this color scheme. After months of waiting and repeated errors, “just get a refund” doesn’t fix the time and planning already invested.
Premium prices should come with premium service and basic quality control. Instead, this experience has been defined by repeated mistakes, poor communication, and a complete lack of accountability.
Three wrong orders, two months wasted, and still no resolution.
Buyers should be aware.
corrections.Support_reply:
Hi Edward,
We’re truly sorry for the frustration you’ve experienced. Receiving the incorrect item multiple times is not the standard we hold ourselves to, and we understand how disappointing this has been.
Our team has worked directly with the supplier to correct the fulfillment issue tied to this item, and a replacement has been sent. We have also ensured you are not required to return the prior shipments.
We appreciate you bringing this to our attention, as feedback like this helps us address issues quickly and improve the experience we provide at Lulu and Georgia. Please reach out to our support team directly if there’s anything further we can assist with.

corrections.Raw_text:
Misleading and Frustrating Experience with Lulu & Georgia
My experience with Lulu & Georgia has been extremely disappointing. Their policies are unclear, inconsistently applied, and ultimately left me paying for services they are now refusing to provide.
I spent just under $18,000 on outdoor furniture, including $1,307 in delivery fees for what was presented as white glove delivery—a service that includes placement of furniture and removal of all packaging. Based on that, I reasonably expected all large items to be delivered and set up accordingly. At no point was it clearly communicated otherwise.
Instead, over the past month, I’ve received a steady stream of deliveries—many via FedEx—without placement or packaging removal. The volume has been so excessive that one entire bay of my garage is now unusable.
Trying to resolve this has been equally frustrating. There is no direct phone support, and reaching a real person was not an option. When I finally connected with customer service, via email I was told that delivery methods are “clearly stated” on each product page. However, this information is inconsistent. Some items that were shipped via FedEx were listed as “white glove delivery,” yet that service was not honored.
When I asked whether customers are expected to review each individual product page to determine delivery logistics, I was given no clear answer—despite asking multiple times.
I also requested assistance with placing the larger items I physically cannot move, but was told no. This leaves me in the position of having to hire movers and arrange disposal of excessive packaging—services I already paid Lulu & Georgia to provide.
Their resolution was a $150 credit, which does not come close to addressing the inconvenience or additional costs I now face.
For a company operating at this price point, the lack of transparency, accountability, and customer support is unacceptable. I even attempted to escalate the issue by including founder Sara Sugarman in correspondence, but received no response.
If you are considering a large purchase, I strongly recommend looking elsewhere. This experience has been unnecessarily stressful and far from what was promised.
corrections.Support_reply:
Hi Denise,
Thank you for reaching out and sharing your experience. I can see how frustrating this situation has been, and we sincerely appreciate your patience. We want to assure you that our third-party freight carrier will complete the White Glove service, including the removal of any packaging left from previous deliveries, during your upcoming appointment. Please let us know if there’s anything else we can assist you with in the meantime, we are happy to help.
Lulu and Georgia

corrections.Raw_text:
I have ordered twice from this company. First time there was an extended delay in receiving the products and I kept initiating the communication. They really should have done that. They apologized and reimbursed shipping without request so that's more than expected
This second time my order was received damaged and it was my full order although they said one item would be shipped at a later date. They responded immediately to my concern and I in turn sent immediate request of picture and later that it was the larger container that had broken because I was to receive only the smaller container from there shipping invoice. Now I have heard nothing. Maybe they are on vacation which is fine but t then don't say "you wish to expedite sending new product" when there is no turn around within a 24 hour business day.
corrections.Support_reply:
Hi Jean,
Thank you for your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the delays and the damage to your order. Our Customer Support team has issued a credit for your shipping fees, and we are currently processing a replacement canister for the damaged item. We will send you the tracking information as soon as it becomes available. Thank you for your patience, and please let us know if you have any further questions. We are happy to help!
Lulu and Georgia

corrections.Raw_text: The prices are high, but I do like the items that I did not return. The return process for returning multiple items is nonexistent online. I had to email customer service as per the instructions, and it took days for response. Once I finally got a response regarding the items I wish to return, I then waited for a second email which then asked me to take photos of the items to be returned. I have never heard of such policy. Then instead of waiting for a response to that email, I went to the website and processed individual returns and had to ship them each individually. When I questioned the return process in one of the emails, I feel the response was rude as I was “kindly reminded” about the process and was told it would take weeks for my refund because the products had to be inspected. Fortunately, it didn’t take that long, but I won’t be ordering again.
corrections.Support_reply:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We sincerely apologize for the frustration caused by the delays in communication and the return process.
We understand how disappointing it is when a return experience feels complicated or unclear, especially after waiting for assistance from our Customer Care team. While some returns may require additional information or photos to help our team properly review the request, we’re sorry this process did not feel seamless in your case and that our communication left you feeling unsupported.
We do appreciate your feedback, as it helps us identify areas where we can improve both our response times and overall customer experience. We’re also glad to hear you are enjoying the items you decided to keep.
Again, we apologize for your experience and appreciate you giving Lulu and Georgia a try.

Delivery was outrageously expensive and box arrived damaged (over $100 to ship PILLOWS??)
Two of the pillows were the wrong ones. I was later informed that they didn't have the ones I originally ordered.
In one of the pillows I found a tag from the supplier for $55 for the pillow cover. Lulu and Georgia *charged me $318 for that pillow*. Absolutely insane markup that cannot be justified.
Incredibly problematic on multiple fronts. I really wanted to have a good experience with my first order because the stuff is really cute, but I cannot support these types of business practices.

We do see that a member of our team assisted with this matter, and we truly appreciate your patience while the refund was processed and reflected.
Thank you for your feedback, and we apologize again that your first experience did not meet expectations.

corrections.Raw_text:
We received the custom built Chaise and, thanks to the sales women, we also purchased a matching swivel chair. They match perfectly!
The details associated with shipping were incorrect. My shop app notified me of the shipper and tracking order -- they were both incorrect. When I emailed LuLu support, a couple days later they apologized for the incorrect information, but never provided the correct information.
The shop app still has in incorrect information -- states Old Dominion Freight Line (they couldn't find any information), but thankfully, Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery called and arranged deliver!
Note that the Chaise had a slit in the bottom, since that's just the protective fabric on the bottom, we accepted delivery (using our cameras, I verified the delivery team did not cut the bottom).
corrections.Support_reply:
Howard,
We are pleased to hear that the chaise and swivel chair match perfectly. We sincerely apologize for the incorrect shipping information and the inconvenience this caused. We are also sorry to learn about the slit in the protective fabric on the bottom of the chaise. We are reviewing our processes to prevent similar issues in the future.
Lulu and Georgia

corrections.Raw_text:
I purchased two 8' x 10' hand-knotted wool rugs from Lulu and Georgia (the Tahj and Kate rugs), each costing around $2,000.
While the rugs are beautiful initially, I experienced significant durability/quality concerns under normal household use. The Tahj rug developed excessive shedding and visible thinning/bare spots and had to be replaced. The Kate rug later began unraveling along the edges.
To Lulu and Georgia’s credit, they did acknowledge the issues and offered store credit compensation. However, after experiencing quality concerns with multiple rugs from the same order, I did not feel comfortable accepting store credit and being expected to purchase additional expensive products from the company. I was disappointed that a refund to the original payment method was not offered instead.
I’m sharing this simply so future buyers can make an informed decision, especially given the premium price point.
corrections.Support_reply:
Hi Halley,
Thank you for your feedback. At this time, we are unable to process a refund to your original payment method because the rugs have worn over time, which falls outside our typical refund policy. However, as a one-time courtesy, we offered you a store credit which can be applied toward any future purchase. If you have any questions or need assistance with utilizing your credit or finding a replacement, please let me know. We are happy to help.
Lulu and Georgia

I ordered a dried flower wreath. When it arrived, the leaves on the wreath were covered in a white powdery mold. The wreath looked like it had been sitting in storage for more than a year. I did not want to take the trouble to send it back due to the bulky nature of the wreath. It was deposited in the trash.
I will not order another dried flower wreath from Lulu and Georgia.

Hi Stephanie,
We are incredibly sorry your wreath arrived in this condition. This is absolutely not our standard, and we certainly do not expect you to return a damaged item.

corrections.Raw_text:
Purchased a wool rug during a 4th of July sale. Shipping was incredibly quick (bought the night of the 8th, was delivered the 11th). There's always a gamble when ordering online that colors aren't adjusted to be true to life, but the rug color was exactly as pictured.
Wish the rug pad ordered along with the rug had made it before the rug itself, but that's just being nitpicky. The rug is thick and plush enough that it really doesn't even need the pad. It flattened out immediately - no annoying corner rolling. It's shedding a bit, but that's to be expected with a new, higher pile wool rug. Love it!
corrections.Support_reply:
Hi Megan,
We are so glad to hear that you are enjoying your new wool rug, and that the color was exactly as you expected. It's wonderful to know that the shipping was quick, and that the rug flattened out immediately without any corner rolling. We appreciate your positive feedback!
Lulu and Georgia

We love the look of this sofa — the design and style are exactly what drew us to it, and it looks beautiful in our space. However, we’ve been disappointed in the quality so far.

We’re hopeful the fabric will relax over time, but the foam/filling quality has been a letdown given the price point. If you’re mainly shopping for looks, this delivers but we’d temper expectations on comfort and construction.

Interesting that I’ve been getting multiple emails daily about what “great taste you’ve got” and “here’s our latest edits”, but it’s been seventy two hours and still no response regarding my return and refund. I suggest you spend more of your resources replying to legitimate customer service concerns and a little less on empty marketing ploys.***
I received the wrong item last week, and spent so much of my own time having to take photos, send screenshots, get out the measuring tape to prove to the chatbot that they, in fact, sent the wrong item. The human I ended up virtually “chatting” with told me that I was wrong and that sometimes items look bigger in the box than they actually are. This was after I sent them photos of the box with the item name, item number and photos of the light itself. The item I ordered (Bobbin Sconce) is 10.5 inches wide. The one they sent (Bobbin Flush Mount) is a completely different name, silhouette, and 6 inches larger (16 inches wide). I had to wait 48 hours for a response from lulu and Georgia, who finally admitted they were in the wrong and provided a shipping label for the return. I had to drive to a fedex location to send the item back. I just received what was supposed to be the corrected replacement today, opened the box, and discovered they sent the same (incorrect) item I received the first time. The Bobbin Flush Mount. Which I do not want. Which I did not order. So I have to go through this entire process again. What an appalling waste of time. I’m so surprised that the glorious Heidi Caillier and Portola Paint are in business with folks that have such inefficient customer service. It’s a real shame. The items look appealing, there’s clearly great folks styling there, but the way the business is run seems to be a complete mess. Stick with Claude, Hay, The Expert, DWR, buy direct from Huey Lightshop and the other designers on here. If you want Heidi Caillier or one of their other designers, many are at Joon Loloi. Heck, ZaraHome has a similar sconce that’s a quarter of the price as the one here. And their service is light years ahead of Lulu and Georgia.
corrections.Support_reply:
Hi Virginia,
Thank you for your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience regarding the incorrect replacement item. Our Customer support team has assisted you with a resolution, but please let us know if you have any further questions or if there's anything else we can do to help.
Lulu and Georgia

corrections.Raw_text:
Customer service isn’t very cooperative and responses are pretty much, “too bad”.
The bought a custom sofa in May for a little under $4000, which includes delivery. It didn’t get delivered until August. It had automatically heckled me out with Shop a without picking up my new address. I was emailed them immediately to change it, but still had issues with my old address while it was in transit. When it was delivered the delivery guys just threw down the pieces on the sidewalk before unpacking it.
I got a monarch pillow and that finally got corrected in October.
By June there was a tear in the sofa in spot that doesn’t get touched. I’m pretty sure it’s because it was sewn too tightly. Their response was its normal wear and tear.
Their products are too over priced for the quality. They offer no protection for the pieces that other places provide such as warranties. I suggest shopping elsewhere

We appreciate your patience and the opportunity to review this further.
